……軍の攻撃を警戒してる割に 城内はずいぶん手薄だよね？
Entry.EnglishText: ...You'd think security inside would be tighter considering the military are ready to strike any second now, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦力は城門に集中させてるはずよ。 この聖都は、少数精鋭での防衛を 考えて設計された街なのよ
Entry.EnglishText: They're probably concentrating their entire force defending the castle gates. This city was designed with defense in mind, after all.

Entry.JapaneseText: それに教会は ゼロム憑依兵の存在を知らないから 油断もしてるわね
Entry.EnglishText: Besides, the church doesn't know about the xeromorphic soldiers, so they're probably letting their guards down.

Entry.JapaneseText: 油断って、ゼロム憑依兵の力は 結晶騎士並みだよぉ？ しかも数は教会の何倍も……
Entry.EnglishText: No kidding.. aren't the xeromorphic soldiers just as strong as the Crystal Knights? But there's like... WAY more of them.

Entry.JapaneseText: 痛っ！
Entry.EnglishText: OUCHIES!

Entry.JapaneseText: おい、そこのチビ！ ボールを拾え!!
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, you! The little one! Toss that back!!

Entry.JapaneseText: 『ごめんね、お姉さん ボールを拾ってください』 ……でしょぉ!?
Entry.EnglishText: How about “Oh I'm so sorry, Ms! Can you pass the ball back, please?”...?!

Entry.JapaneseText: おい、そこの変なカッコのチビ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, weird lookin' girl!

Entry.JapaneseText: ボールをひろってくださ…… ちがった……ひろえっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Can you toss... wait no, PASS the ball back?

Entry.JapaneseText: 礼儀を知らない子どもたちだなっ！ 口の利き方を教えてやるぅ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Where are these kid's manners?! I'll teach them a thing or two~~

Entry.JapaneseText: やれるもんなら、やってみろ〜！
Entry.EnglishText: I'd like to see you try~!

Entry.JapaneseText: 何やってんだ…… 置いてくぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: Quit mucking about... Hey, get back here!

Entry.JapaneseText: うわぁぁ〜〜〜ッ！
Entry.EnglishText: AAARGH!

Entry.JapaneseText: どうした、<Beryl>!?
Entry.EnglishText: Beryl, are you okay!?

Entry.JapaneseText: あいあい傘の下に スピンとネルの名前が書いてある
なかなかの達筆で 『やばい…… プニプニがつっかえた！』
『ぬ、抜け出せない。 助けてぇ〜〜隊長ぉ！ バイロクスぅ〜』と書いてある
どこに出ますか？
Entry.EnglishText: Where are you going?

Entry.JapaneseText: フィールドに出る 街道に出る
Entry.EnglishText: To Field. To pathways.

スピンの宝物を探しますか？
Entry.EnglishText: Look for Spin's treasure?

Entry.JapaneseText: はい いいえ
Entry.EnglishText: Yes. No.

Entry.JapaneseText: スピンの宝物を発見しました ！
Entry.EnglishText: Found Spin's treasure!

Entry.JapaneseText: 何も見つかりませんでした
Entry.EnglishText: There's nothing here to be found.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……攻防戦が始まれば おそらく南門が主戦場に なるでしょうけど……
Entry.EnglishText: Once the battle starts, the south gate's gonna take the biggest hit.

Entry.JapaneseText: 北大陸を迂回した軍の別働隊が 北門を襲う可能性も高い
Entry.EnglishText: There's a high chance that the army who's coming from the north side will attack the northern gates.

Entry.JapaneseText: 警戒をおこたる訳にはいかないわ
Entry.EnglishText: We need to stay on our toes.

Entry.JapaneseText: 確かに教主アーカムは ソーマの武力を背景に 帝国の政治を専断した……
Entry.EnglishText: I think Father Arkham mentioned something about the force of a Soma being a background reason behind the empire's motivations...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……けど、あんな化物兵士を 使ってまでして、教会を 倒す必要があったのかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: But what reason even is there for them to employ these demonic soldiers against us?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 北大陸の村々に プランスールに避難するよう 呼びかけているの
Entry.EnglishText: There's been a call for people to evacuate to the villages north of Pransule for safety.

Entry.JapaneseText: ひとりでも多くの人を 収容できるといいんだけど
Entry.EnglishText: Even if just one place does, it would be so wonderful for people to be able to escape this situation.

Entry.JapaneseText: 教主アーカム様の命で 聖都の北門は閉鎖された！
Entry.EnglishText: By Father Arkham's orders, we have closed the northern gate!

Entry.JapaneseText: 我がソーマにかけて なん人も通さんぞ!!
Entry.EnglishText: On my Soma, I swear, not a single person shall pass!

Entry.JapaneseText: 兵士は、ただ命令に従えばいい……
Entry.EnglishText: All soldiers have to do is obey their orders.

Entry.JapaneseText: 兵士は、ただ命令に従うだけだ
Entry.EnglishText: That's all we're meant to do.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……例え、仲間がスピリアを失い 白い彫像になったとしても……な
Entry.EnglishText: Even if my friends lose their Spiria and become calcified...

Entry.JapaneseText: ふふふ、まさか軍と肩を 並べて戦う日が来ようとは……
Entry.EnglishText: Heh. Never thought the day would come when we'd join shoulders with the army.

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、これで化物どもに マクス帝国——
Entry.EnglishText: But if these monsters infest Max Empire...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……いや、人間の力を 存分にみせてやれるぞ!!
Entry.EnglishText: No. We'll show those beasts the power of mankind!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……攻防戦が始まれば おそらく南門が主戦場に なるでしょうけど……
Entry.EnglishText: Once the battle starts, the south gate's gonna take the biggest hit.

Entry.JapaneseText: 城門は固く閉ざされている
Entry.EnglishText: The castle gate is firmly shut.

ここはバレイア教会が 運営する孤児院なんです
Entry.EnglishText: This is an orphanage managed by the church.

Entry.JapaneseText: 統一戦争以来、身寄りのない 子どもたちを何百人も引き取って 育ててきたんですよ
Entry.EnglishText: Since the Unification War, there's been hundreds of orphaned children, so we watch over them here.

Entry.JapaneseText: 教会の活動はとめられて しまいました…… ……けれど
Entry.EnglishText: The church's operations have halted.

Entry.JapaneseText: 軍にかけあって、孤児院の 存続は認めてもらいました！
Entry.EnglishText: However, I negotiated with the army, and they allowed us to keep the orphanage running.

Entry.JapaneseText: 子どもたちには 罪はないんですものっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: The children have done nothing wrong!

Entry.JapaneseText: クリードとかいう人には 腹が立ちます!!
Entry.EnglishText: That Creed person makes me furious!

Entry.JapaneseText: 子どもたちのスピリアまで 吸おうとするなんて許せません!!
Entry.EnglishText: How dare he suck the Spiria out of poor, innocent children! Unforgivable!

Entry.JapaneseText: 会ったら、ぶん殴って やるんだから！
Entry.EnglishText: If I ever meet him, I'll give him a proper slapping!

Entry.JapaneseText: オママゴトしたいなぁー
Entry.EnglishText: I wanna play house!

Entry.JapaneseText: ねぇ、オママゴトしない？
Entry.EnglishText: Will you play house with me?

Entry.JapaneseText: アタシがママで アナタは赤ちゃんね♪
Entry.EnglishText: I'll be the mommy, and you'll be the baby!

Entry.JapaneseText: ううっ……もう せんそうはイヤだよぉ……
Entry.EnglishText: Uu... I don't like fighting...

Entry.JapaneseText: せんそうは…… すごくすごくコワイもん……
Entry.EnglishText: War is really really scary...

Entry.JapaneseText: こわいときは、みんなに 手をにぎってもらうといいよ
Entry.EnglishText: I think everyone should hold hands when things are scary.

Entry.JapaneseText: アタシがないてると みんなが手をにぎってくれるの
Entry.EnglishText: I want people to hold my hand when I'm crying.

Entry.JapaneseText: そうすると、ちょっとだけ こわいのがなくなるんだぁ
Entry.EnglishText: Then it's not so scary anymore.

Entry.JapaneseText: 父ちゃんや母ちゃんはいないけど ぜんぜん、さみしくないよ
Entry.EnglishText: My daddy and mommy are gone, but I'm not lonely or anything.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここには、うるさい兄弟が い〜〜〜っぱいいるからさ！
Entry.EnglishText: I have way too many rowdy brothers to deal with!

Entry.JapaneseText: …………ほんとだよ？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Seriously?

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦争って……イヤだよね……
Entry.EnglishText: I don't like wars...

Entry.JapaneseText: こ、怖いんじゃないぞ!? イヤなだけなんだ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I-I'm not scared of them or anything! I just don't like them.

Entry.JapaneseText: ガルデニアなんて ぜーんぜん怖くないね！
Entry.EnglishText: I-I'm not scared of Gardenia at all!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……おれが怖がると 小さいヤツらがもっと 怖がるからね……
Entry.EnglishText: If I look scared, then all the younger ones will be scared too, so...

Entry.JapaneseText: へへ、兄貴はツライよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe, being a big brother to everyone is tough work.

Entry.JapaneseText: ブブゥ……
Entry.EnglishText: Bui!

Entry.JapaneseText: ブゥゥ〜〜〜
Entry.EnglishText: Bui bui!

Entry.JapaneseText: 聞いた？ 帝都でたいへんな事件が 起こったらしいわよ
Entry.EnglishText: Did you hear the news that the empire got itself in a bad situation?

Entry.JapaneseText: まさか軍と教会の戦争が 始まったりしないわよねぇ……？
Entry.EnglishText: You don't think the army and church will start a war, do you?

Entry.JapaneseText: たった一日で あの美しかったプランスールが メチャクチャになっちまった……
Entry.EnglishText: To think such a beautiful city as Pransule would become such a mess overnight...

Entry.JapaneseText: 女神リチア様は、私たちを 助けてくれないんだねぇ……
Entry.EnglishText: Goddess Lithia, please, do watch over us...

Entry.JapaneseText: もう女神様なんて アテにしないよ！
Entry.EnglishText: I won't count my prayers to the goddess anymore! I won't go to her for help!

Entry.JapaneseText: 母親として、子どもは 死んでも守るよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: As a mother, I'll die protecting my children!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ダンナはともかく
Entry.EnglishText: My husband is a different story.

Entry.JapaneseText: そうそう、カルセドニー様が 皇帝陛下を斬りつけたんですって!!
Entry.EnglishText: Oh yeah, Chalcedony took a swing at the empress!

Entry.JapaneseText: おふたりは許婚のはずなのにねぇ？ やっぱりアレは本当なのかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: Weren't the two of them engaged?! Don't tell me the rumors were true?

Entry.JapaneseText: 帝位を奪う目的の 政略結婚だっていう噂……
Entry.EnglishText: Of course, I mean that Chalcedony was only marrying into the empire to steal the throne from her.

Entry.JapaneseText: 白く固まった兵士を見た？ アレは何だったのかしら??
Entry.EnglishText: Did you see the calcified soldiers? What's up with that?

Entry.JapaneseText: 教主様も結晶騎士たちも 帝都エストレーガに 連行されたらしいわ
Entry.EnglishText: Father and the Crystal Knights were taken away to the imperial empire Estraga.

Entry.JapaneseText: そうそう！ 『母はガルデニアより強し』よ!!
Entry.EnglishText: That's right! A mother is stronger than Gardenia, you hear!

Entry.JapaneseText: 子どもたちのスピリアを 渡してなるもんですかっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: As if I'd ever let you steal the Spiria of children like that!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ダンナはともかく
Entry.EnglishText: My husband is a different story.

Entry.JapaneseText: わん……
Entry.EnglishText: Woof...

Entry.JapaneseText: わぉん…………
Entry.EnglishText: *whine*...

Entry.JapaneseText: わんッ！
Entry.EnglishText: Woof!

Entry.JapaneseText: わん！ わん!!
Entry.EnglishText: Woof woof!

Entry.JapaneseText: わんだーーーーッッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Woooof!

Entry.JapaneseText: サンテクス大聖堂は プランスールの西側の島だよ
Entry.EnglishText: Saint-Exus Cathedral is on the westernmost island of Pransule.

Entry.JapaneseText: 大聖堂の隣には 教会が無料で人々を治療する 救護院があるんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Next to the Cathedral is a free-to-use relief center supplied by the church.

Entry.JapaneseText: 軍も一般のバレイア教徒には 酷い弾圧をしていない
Entry.EnglishText: The army doesn't tend to oppress your ordinary Velleia follower.

Entry.JapaneseText: 軍が潰したかったのは 教主様と結晶騎士団だった ようだ……
Entry.EnglishText: What the army hates is Father and the Crystal Knights.

Entry.JapaneseText: バレイアの教え『人々の融和』……
Entry.EnglishText: Velleia's teachings speak of harmony of the people.

Entry.JapaneseText: やろうと意気ごむと えらく難しいのに 気がつくとできていたりする……
Entry.EnglishText: When you try to do it, it's hard, but then you end up just doing it without realizing it.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……不思議なもんじゃなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: It's strange, isn't it?

Entry.JapaneseText: 話しかけないでっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Don't talk to me right now!

Entry.JapaneseText: トンネルがくずれるだろ!!
Entry.EnglishText: The tunnel's falling!

Entry.JapaneseText: 話しかけないでって……
Entry.EnglishText: I said, don't talk to me!

Entry.JapaneseText: あーーーーーっっ！！？
Entry.EnglishText: Whoa?!

Entry.JapaneseText: ほらみろぉー！ くずれちゃったじゃないかぁ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Look! It fell!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……人生って 砂場と同じだよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Life is just like a sandbox...

Entry.JapaneseText: 一生懸命つくったものも 一瞬にしてくずれちゃう……
Entry.EnglishText: All the things you work so hard for just make you tumble like in a sandbox...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……世の中に くずれないものなんてない……
Entry.EnglishText: There's nothing in this world that won't tumble eventually.

Entry.JapaneseText: くずれるとわかっているのに 何かをつくらずにいられないのが 人間なんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Doing things even if you know they'll fall apart at some point is what makes us human.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……むなしいけど…… ちょっとステキだよね
Entry.EnglishText: Even if things are fruitless, it's a cool way to live.

Entry.JapaneseText: このシーソーは オレがセンリョーした！
Entry.EnglishText: I think a lot while playing on this seesaw!

Entry.JapaneseText: めずらしい味のアメをもってきたら ギッコンバッタンさせてやっても いいぜ？
Entry.EnglishText: If you bring me a unique tasting candy, I'll let you play on it.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世の中ってシーソーと にてるな……
Entry.EnglishText: The world is like seesaws...

Entry.JapaneseText: 一方が上がれば 一方は下がる…… 軍と教会のカンケーのようにね
Entry.EnglishText: One side goes up while the other side goes down. It's just like the army and church.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……このシーソーはオレが守る！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll protect this seesaw with my life!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレのユメは、かわいいカノジョと 一緒にシーソーに乗る事なんだ!!
Entry.EnglishText: My dream is to ride this seesaw with a cute girlfriend on the other side!
